authority_boundary: This card identifies ontology and identifier grammar only. The source's internal active-authority label does not settle human rulings, authored prose, game mechanics, source precedence, or mappings inferred by a legacy extraction. Literal identifiers remain evidence until accepted; open grammar decisions remain open.
